places.description: Rockwood Apartment Homes is an apartment community in north Austin, Texas, serving as a private home-base stay for the trip.
places.name: Rockwood Apartment Homes

places.description: Cork and Pig Tavern is a San Angelo-born Texas tavern with a branch in Abilene, known for wood-fired pizzas, craft cocktails, and casual American fare.
places.name: Cork and Pig Tavern

places.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Amarillo, Texas, used as lodging during the Panhandle portion of the trip.
places.name: 4803 Mc Kinley Ln

places.description: OVR-EZE is a breakfast and brunch restaurant in Amarillo, Texas, known for inventive dishes like the Croi-ffle, a waffle pressed from croissant dough.
places.name: OVR-EZE

places.description: Palo Duro Canyon State Park near Amarillo protects the second-largest canyon in the United States, famed for red-rock cliffs and the Lighthouse formation.
places.name: Palo Duro Canyon State Park

places.description: The Big Texan Steak Ranch & Brewery is a Route 66-era steakhouse in Amarillo, Texas, home of the 72-ounce steak challenge.
places.name: The Big Texan Steak Ranch & Brewery

places.description: Cadillac Ranch is a public art installation west of Amarillo where ten graffiti-covered Cadillacs stand buried nose-first in a field.
places.name: Cadillac Ranch

places.description: Jimmy's Egg is a regional breakfast and lunch chain restaurant in Amarillo, Texas, serving omelets, pancakes, and classic diner fare.
places.name: Jimmy's Egg

places.description: Caprock Canyons State Park & Trailway near Quitaque, Texas, features rugged red canyons and is home to the official Texas State Bison Herd.
places.name: Caprock Canyons State Park & Trailway

places.description: Allsup's is a convenience store chain widespread across New Mexico and West Texas, its Spur location a practical stop for fuel and snacks.
places.name: Allsup's Convenience Store
